dw_blue_splash.use: Tidal Bore / River Mouth / Delta: the big splash on a hit, a crown of water rising with white tips, breaking into drops and falling back into a pale ring (one shot, ~0.33 s). Anchor = the hit's foot.

dw_floodgate_froth.use: Floodgate: for the surge's 3 s each water step heaves and goes pale, two ragged bands of froth rolling across it (tiles along the water every 32 px; over the water surface, under the nightmares); the nightmares' stagger is a shake in code. Anchor = the route point.

dw_floodgate_froth_end.use: Floodgate: the froth tile for each END of the surged water (its last drawn point; flip it for the first), the same frames as dw_floodgate_froth with its right half rounding off like the water's rounded end, so the froth never stops in a hard edge. Anchor = the route point.

dw_footprints.use: Wet Footprints: the nightmare's wet dragging trail, two ragged smears with a cold wet shine (frames alternate down the path); fade them with alpha over PRINT_SECONDS. Anchor = the route point.

dw_heavy_cling.use: Heavy Water: water heaped round one nightmare's legs, a white crest sloshing on its front, foam trailing behind it in dashes as it walks (drawn walking right: flip it walking left). Under the nightmare, over the wading cover. Anchor = its feet.

dw_mud.use: Mudflats: a wet mud patch on each mud step, a small puddle eye in it (frame 1 a bubble instead); pick by route index; on the ground under the water's damp band. Anchor = the route point.

dw_reeds.use: Reed Bed: a reed clump standing in the carried water, a cattail on the tallest, swaying (stands on the bank: y-sort it, or draw it over the water). Anchor = its foot at the water line.

dw_still_sheen.use: Still Water: the water goes mirror-still and a pale crescent moon shows in it, wavering a little (on the water surface, one every few steps). Anchor = the route point.

dw_tidal_bore.use: Tidal Bore: a tidal wave rolling with the tough nightmare through the mouth, heaving, its lip curling forward in foam (drawn rolling right: flip it rolling left); drawn just behind the nightmare. Anchor = the wave's foot, under the nightmare.

dw_wave_flash.use: Breaking Wave / Flash Flood: a wave that rises, curls a white lip and breaks into foam and spray, then fades (one shot, ~0.43 s). Flip it when the wave runs right to left. Anchor = the water's middle.

kt_allegro_note.use: Allegro: a kept Toll, two beamed quick notes in bronze with a motion streak, circling the bell (up to 3). Anchor = between the note heads.

kt_bronze_prime.use: Down the Line / Both Ways: a primed nightmare's mark, a small bronze bell lit from the upper left, its clapper swinging (over its pips). Its ring arcs can use the same ramp: Oak, Ember, Gold. Anchor = the bell's lip.

kt_counter_note.use: Counterpoint: one small note per kind over the nightmare, modulated (multiplier) by that kind's colour; space them 6 px apart, at most 4. Frame 0 hanging, frame 1 flashing at the toll. Anchor = the note head's foot.

kt_humming_pip.use: Humming Walls: the pip a wall filled, a thorn-wrapped bead in Thornwall colours with hum arcs pulsing outward. Anchor = centre.

kt_tally.use: Last Bell / Curfew / Passing Bell / Last Rites: a dark bronze plaque with a shield bottom hanging by a cord from a nail over the nightmare, a rivet each side. Frame 0 the plaque, frame 1 struck (rung out). Code draws kt_tally_mark on its face (top left of the marks at (5, 7); the face runs x 5..13, y 7..11): one group of five, then a count. Anchor = its bottom middle.

kt_tally_mark.use: Last Bell: the tally's engraved marks. Frame 0 one stroke, a 1 px Glow cut lit Heartlight at its top, 1 px in from the frame's left (the plaque's face shows between strokes): advance 2 px per stroke; four strokes span 8 px. Frame 1 the slash, a 1 px Orchid line with a Night shadow, drawn at the same top left as the first stroke, crossing all four. Anchor = top left.

lf_constellation_pip.use: Constellation: one small warm star per different Warden counted (and the star's charges). Draw faint dotted Gold lines (alpha 0.4) from each pip to the star so it reads as a star chart. Anchor = centre.

lf_constellation_star.use: Constellation: the star lit over a nightmare, warm (Heartlight core, Glow and Gold rays, a banded halo). Anchor = centre.

lf_full_glow_ring.use: Full Glow: eight firefly motes circling a lit nightmare's feet in a faint pool of light (on the ground, under it). Anchor = centre.

lf_lantern.use: Early Lamps / Carried / Late Lanterns / Lantern Alley / Hunting Lantern: the small lantern over a nightmare. Frame 0 dim (between glows); frames 1-2 lit, 3-4 blazing: code loops the pair itself at the sheet's fps (the flame flickers, the halo shimmers); not a plain looping animation. Anchor = its base's foot.

lf_moth_flame.use: Moth to Flame: the kept crit, a tall flame with a moth circling and dipping to it (LanternMark; was circles at (10, -32)). Anchor = the flame's foot.

lf_moth_flame_ready.use: Moth to Flame, ready (its 4 hits are in): the flame burns hotter with a denser halo and the moth's wings catch fire. Same frames and anchor as lf_moth_flame.

lf_pale_path_dot.use: Sightline: a warm eye-shaped gleam on each pale-path step that blinks slowly (on the ground). Anchor = the step's centre.

lf_streak_flare.use: Lantern Alley: the lantern's flare each time its streak grows, an ember ring bursting with sparks flying out (fire, not a bell's ring; one shot, 5 frames, ~0.36 s). Three tiers, never scaled: frames 0-4 streak 2, 5-9 streak 3-4, 10-14 streak 5+ (bigger ring, more sparks). Anchor = centre (the lantern's flame).

lf_strung_pip.use: Strung Lights: one fairy-light bulb per glow entered, hung 6 px apart: their strings join into one line. Anchor = the string at the bulb's top.

lf_waiting_flame.use: Bonfire: a little bonfire, a two-tongued flame on crossed sticks, over a nightmare holding a waiting crit (LanternMark; was two circles at (-10, -30)). Anchor = the sticks' foot.

sp_black_spot.use: Black Spot: a solid black (Root) rot spot over the marked nightmare's head, a Night outline lit Bruise on its upper left, three orchid pustules on it pulsing together. Anchor = its foot, at the head-mark point.

sp_cap_badge.use: Host Trees: the cap a Warden of another family wears. Frame 0 its own cap (Blossom), frame 1 a passed-on cap (Spreading Caps: pale). Anchor = the stem's foot, on the Warden's head.

sp_deep_rot_ring.use: Deep Rot: every 10 steps a dark green rot ring swells out from under the boss, a moss light on its front, then breaks into chunks that sink (one shot, 0.5 s, on the ground). Anchor = its feet.

sp_fed_ground.use: Feeding Ground: a fed patch on each route point, pink spore dust settling and two curled shoots swaying; fade it with alpha as its 8 s run out. Anchor = the route point.

sp_rot_ring.use: Rot Ground: a rotten ring on a Sprout bed's step, fallen grey cap stubs on it and a pink spore wisp rising (on the ground). Anchor = the step's route point.

sp_season_haze.use: Spore Season: a low green spore haze lying over each trail step while the Season is lit, pink spores rising out of it (on the ground, over the path, under the nightmares; flip every other step's tile so the trail doesn't repeat). Anchor = the route point.

sp_spore_fleck.use: Host Trees: the pink spore fleck where a capped Warden's tick or hit lands (one shot, ~0.33 s). Anchor = the hit point.

sp_spot_fleck.use: Black Spot: the black rot splat that lands on each Warden as it hits the marked nightmare, drops flicked off it (drawn flicking up-right: flip it toward the Warden; one shot, ~0.33 s). Anchor = the splat on the Warden.

sp_throne_rim.use: Toadstool Throne: a throne made of mushroom, drawn under the clump (before the mushroom sheet; the clump stands in front): a great toadstool cap tipped upright behind it, its brown gill underside fanning from a pale stem stub, a gold and Ember rim, a three-point crown on top (a glint sweeps its points), two little toadstool armrests and a squat plinth. Anchor = the clump's feet.
